title: Physical Science — Laws of the Creator
description: Test your understanding of matter, energy, forces, waves, and light.

questions.question: What is matter?
options: Anything that has mass and takes up space
questions.explanation: Matter is defined as anything that has mass and takes up space. This includes solids, liquids, and gases.

questions.question: Why does ice float on water?
options: Ice has more mass than water
Ice is less dense than liquid water
Water pushes ice upward with magnetic force
questions.explanation: Ice is less dense than liquid water because water expands when it freezes. This unique property, designed by God, protects aquatic life by insulating water beneath the ice.

questions.question: What determines what element an atom is?
questions.explanation: The atomic number — the number of protons in the nucleus — determines the identity of an element. Every atom with 6 protons is carbon, every atom with 79 protons is gold, etc.

questions.question: Newton's First Law of Motion describes the concept of:
questions.explanation: Newton's First Law describes inertia — the tendency of an object at rest to stay at rest, and an object in motion to stay in motion, unless acted upon by an unbalanced force.

questions.question: The Law of Conservation of Energy states that energy:
options: Can be created but not destroyed
Is always increasing in the universe
Cannot be created or destroyed, only transformed
Only exists in the form of heat
questions.explanation: The Law of Conservation of Energy states that energy cannot be created or destroyed by natural processes — it can only change from one form to another.

questions.question: Sound waves are what type of wave?
questions.explanation: Sound waves are longitudinal waves — the air particles compress and expand in the same direction that the sound travels.

questions.question: What happens when light passes from air into water?
options: It speeds up and bends toward the surface
It slows down and bends, a process called refraction
questions.explanation: When light passes from air into water, it slows down and bends (refracts). This is why objects underwater appear to be in a slightly different position than they actually are.

questions.question: According to Newton's Second Law, the formula F = ma means that:
options: Force equals mass divided by acceleration
More massive objects always move faster
questions.explanation: F = ma means that force equals mass times acceleration. A greater force produces greater acceleration, and a more massive object requires more force to achieve the same acceleration.
